name: Ai for Work
description: AI for Work provides a single, secure connection. Search organizational knowledge with context-aware answers powered by an Enterprise RAG Engine, execute multi-step workflows end to end via the Universal Orchestrator, and leverage ready-to-use solutions like AI for IT, AI for HR and many more alongside custom agents. All interactions respect enterprise security, access permissions, and compliance — making AI genuinely useful at work.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Ai for Work to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Ai for Work to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://work.kore.ai/api/mcp/545459cf-9576-4e78-a812-0efe6bb3b033. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Ai for Work MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ai for Work lists 20 MCP tools, including contacts_find_contact, google_calendar_available_slots, google_calendar_cancel_events, google_calendar_create_detailed_event, google_calendar_find_busy_periods_in_calendar, google_calendar_find_events, google_calendar_update_event, jira_software_cloud_add_comment, jira_software_cloud_add_issues_to_sprint, jira_software_cloud_create_issue, jira_software_cloud_create_sprint, and jira_software_cloud_find_issue_by_key.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Ai for Work?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Ai for Work in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Ai for Work MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ai for Work requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Ai for Work is developed by Kore.ai. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
